files.responsibility: single @Observable session identity, selected state, binding, and composer intent
pure durable and transient row projection and discussion archive folding
candidate action availability, retry blockers, and stable row digests
ask_user approvals and character identity intents
serial batch polish generation and adoption
existing bottom follow reducer and commands
candidate collection, archive, fork, polish transaction, and manual rewrite intents
ghostwrite batch controls, readiness, and outer chapter loop
single chapter generation, review, collect, and sync
ghostwrite pause, background lease, sidecar progress, and resume
presentation row, action, tail, list, window, and projection input value types
pure FIFO presentation buffer and cursor pacing
one prepared index for candidate, run, checkpoint, and gate lookups
session projection cache, identity chrome, revision based installation
run start, attach, consume, stop, retry, durable refresh, and binding reset
binding, run draft, and batch progress value contracts
reasoning/text pacing, structured preview, terminal partial drain and tail retirement

ownership.observableIdentity: NovelSessionViewModel instance remains the only owner of bindingToken, consumer and attachment IDs, transientTail, presentationBuffer and flush tasks, terminalAwaitingRefresh, mutation gate, batch and ghostwrite task/progress. Workflow extensions mutate that same instance; no duplicate store or state machine was added.
ownership.durableAuthority: NovelCreationViewModel delegates domain mutations to the existing DefaultNovelCreation actor, reducer, and repository; Session projection never writes the document.
ownership.runBoundary: projectID and branchID in binding, sessionID in transient tail, runID plus bindingToken in consumer/pacer/terminal, unchanged checks at each callback.
ownership.presentationBoundary: One NovelSessionPresentationBuffer cursor, one 48 ms FIFO flush, then terminal partial drain before durable refresh/tail retirement.
ownership.bottomFollow: NovelSessionBottomFollowPolicy reducer moved intact; no new scroll owner.
